Enabled.Name: Reroll Bonus: Enable
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, rerolling a check with a Hero Point adds a bonus to the new roll's total.

Bonus.Name: Reroll Bonus: Amount
Bonus.Hint: Flat bonus added to the rerolled d20 total. Ignored when Scaling is enabled. Dice bonuses are rolled (and shown by Dice So Nice) alongside the d20.

Label.Name: Reroll Bonus: Label
Label.Hint: Flavor text on the bonus term in the roll formula and chat badge. Blank = "Hero Point".

Scaling.Name: Reroll Bonus: Scale by Level
Scaling.Hint: Use level tiers (Edit Tiers) instead of the flat Amount. Default: 1d4 at level 1, 1d6 at 7, 1d8 at 13.

TiersMenu.Name: Reroll Bonus: Scaling Tiers
TiersMenu.Label: Edit Tiers
TiersMenu.Hint: Set the bonus die for each level tier. Tiers can scale down as well as up.

Tiers.Title: Hero Point Scaling Tiers
Tiers.Hint: At the listed level and above, a Hero Point reroll gets that bonus. The highest tier at or below the character's level wins. Characters below the lowest tier get no bonus.
Tiers.Empty: No tiers. Hero Point rerolls get no bonus while Scaling is enabled.

Enabled.Name: Hero Die: Enable
Enabled.Hint: Give the Reroll Bonus die a bright, polished metal look in Dice So Nice, overriding the roller's colorset and texture. Only applies to dice bonuses, not flat +1/+2/+3.

Color.Name: Hero Die: Color
Color.Hint: Polished Gold (white numbers), Chrome Silver (bright blue numbers, white halo), or Custom (colors below).

CustomColor.Name: Hero Die: Custom Die Color
CustomColor.Hint: Die color when Color is set to Custom. Rendered as polished chrome, so pick a lighter shade than you'd expect.

CustomNumberColor.Name: Hero Die: Custom Number Color
CustomNumberColor.Hint: Number color when Color is set to Custom. The outline is a darker shade of this color.

Enabled.Name: Keep the Better: Enable
Enabled.Hint: Hero Point rerolls keep the higher total (old or new) instead of always taking the new roll. Totals include any Reroll Bonus.

Enabled.Name: Pass the Torch: Enable
Enabled.Hint: Players can give one of their Hero Points to an allied character. Requires a GM to be logged in. Macro: game.modules.get("outrider-hero-points").api.passTheTorch()

HudButton.Name: Pass the Torch: Token HUD Button
HudButton.Hint: Show a torch button on the Token HUD of characters you own.

PassTheTorch.Title: Pass the Torch
PassTheTorch.DialogText: {name} has {value} Hero Point(s). Choose an ally to receive one.
PassTheTorch.Announce: {giver} passes the torch! {recipient} gains a Hero Point.
PassTheTorch.Disabled: Pass the Torch is disabled in the world settings.
PassTheTorch.NoGiver: Select a token you own, or assign a character to your user.
PassTheTorch.NoPoints: {name} has no Hero Points to give.
PassTheTorch.NoAllies: No allied characters can receive a Hero Point.
PassTheTorch.NoGM: Pass the Torch needs a GM online to complete the transfer.
PassTheTorch.Invalid: Pass the Torch failed: giver or recipient not found.
PassTheTorch.NotOwner: Pass the Torch failed: you don't own {name}.
PassTheTorch.NotAllied: Pass the Torch failed: {name} is not an ally.
PassTheTorch.RecipientFull: Pass the Torch failed: {name} already has the maximum Hero Points.
